title: Tetril's Furniture
description: Enhance your MMORPG or Creative server with Tetril's Furniture! This plugin adds detailed furniture and decorations—like Tall Chairs and Scribe Sets—to Minecraft versions 1.21.10 and 1.21.11 without requiring any mods.
body:
![This is the official promotional banner for the "Tetril's Furniture" Minecraft plugin. The image features a stylized, professional layout set against a dark brown, wood-plank texture background.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5784cf6591efece81bf20bbd1934b01ffa618c81_0.webp)



![Minecraft Themed Overview Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93f047e97b4ca6c66d2620f0d86eacb3d17f3eb9.png)

**Tetril's Furniture** is a lightweight, high-performance Spigot plugin designed for **MMoRPG** and **Creative Building** servers. It allows you to enhance your builds with detailed furniture and decorative elements using vanilla mechanics.

Whether you are furnishing a medieval tavern or a player home, Tetril's Furniture provides an immersive experience. **Best of all: Players can actually sit on the chairs!**


![Purple Minecraft themed Key Features Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/217b8fcf935f9cc90f178b5be344a624d9912752.png)

- **Interactive Furniture:** Players can sit on chairs for enhanced roleplay.
![This Minecraft screenshot demonstrates the seating functionality of the furniture plugin. Five high-back chairs of various wood types (Birch, Dark Oak, Diorite/White, Oak, and Spruce) are lined up in a birch forest glade. The setting is a bright, daytime forest with lush green grass, yellow flowers, and several birch trees in the background, highlighting how the furniture integrates into a standard survival or creative world.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3bdc7bfd445fa3d31f15c171619b5b19931d918f.jpeg)
- **Functional Workstations:** Use the new Forge to speed up your smelting by managing heat with coal.
![This image displays a specialized Graphical User Interface (GUI) for the "Blacksmith's Forge" within the Minecraft furniture plugin. The menu is a gray, stone-textured window overlaid on a Minecraft world during twilight.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/419cfcd8424ebb9d5114977cedd06f4807c994c5_0.webp)
- **Intuitive GUI Menu:** Access all items through a clean, categorized interface.
![This image displays the Graphical User Interface (GUI) of the Minecraft furniture plugin, titled "Categories" at the top. The menu is a custom-designed gray stone-textured window overlaying the dark Minecraft world.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/043955025edfb08690c1a2d9fc457ab1fb0f9247_0.webp)
- **Directional Placement:** Items automatically align based on the player's facing direction.
![This top-down perspective shows four identical Scribe's Sets arranged in a circular pattern on a grassy Minecraft floor. Each set consists of two separate decorative elements. The items are placed in a natural setting among green grass, small yellow dandelions, and white flowers. The lighting is bright and sunny, consistent with a clear day in a Minecraft world.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/efeed2b19b22ee0ee712915354e595e13d5a9109_0.webp)
- **Localization:** Supports multiple languages! Switch between **English** and **German** easily via the config file.
![This image is a screenshot of a config.yml configuration file for a Minecraft plugin titled "Tetril's Furniture". The file is shown in a text editor with a dark theme and outlines the localization settings for the plugin. ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4b2452f0b3bcfaaf7bd556f770a9337393f3ebc.png)
- **Build Mode:** A dedicated mode to prevent accidental placement or destruction.
![This Minecraft screenshot illustrates the command-line interface being used to toggle the plugin's "build mode." The player is standing in a grassy forest clearing during the day, with birch trees and hills visible in the background.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb87051de88777c2d62cc49a246893acf44aa0b1_0.webp)

![Purple Minecraft themed Available Items Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b2d2112b6d51cb053ee0a31332ec84000a8b4e03.png)

![Golden Minecraft themed Interior Furniture Subtitle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d1da18c003d527a1021955b170d04ab2b190ffd.png)

**Tall Chairs:** Fully functional chairs you can sit on! Available in:
_Spruce, Oak, Dark Oak, Pale Oak, and Birch._
![This image displays five different variants of a high-back wooden chair, placed side-by-side on a grass surface within a Minecraft birch forest environment. Each chair features a distinctively tall, stepped backrest that reaches a peak in the center, giving it a throne-like appearance. The chairs include sturdy armrests with visible wood-grain circular textures on the front ends and a small rectangular cutout in the upper portion of the backrest. The seats are topped with a thick, textured fabric cushion. In the background, a lush birch forest and a clear blue sky are visible, along with a mini-map in the top-left corner of the interface.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/572498b51f633a1089d5f2f1673b19611cc73726_0.webp)
**Double Beds:** Large, comfortable beds available in: 
_Violet, Green, Red, Pink, and Blue_
![This Minecraft screenshot showcases the Purple Double Bed placed within a cozy, fully decorated interior. The image demonstrates how the furniture model fits naturally into a player-built home.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f4d2409a0354e0c99bc92bc3a257a5cd25df5c0.png)

![Golden Minecraft Themed foliage title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e280545d180cb4f6fcd2b21e126bae7f43f5bee.png)

**Cattail:** Detailed botanical decoration for your landscapes.
![This Minecraft screenshot showcases the Cattails/Reeds furniture models integrated into a natural pond environment. The image highlights how these custom plants enhance waterfront landscaping.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63c911c619e9d767ab7c52d4e6d5b2b134c5aa71.jpeg)

![Golden Minecraft Themed Decoration Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35ca147b44fe52b4c1cc7feafe6eb3b51b98c83d.png)

**Scribe Set:** Add detail to libraries, offices, or wizard towers.
![This Minecraft screenshot features the Scribe's Set displayed on a wooden desk, showcasing its use as a detailed interior decoration.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bfdb13c04f4d810ac46f8c9372b814d13b609af2.png)

![Golden Minecraft themed Workstations title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77c058079be62936b4c3cd0e93c0de7a79860aa6.png)

**Forge:** A Tuff-based workstation that uses coal to generate heat for faster smelting.
![This Minecraft screenshot features the Blacksmith's Forge furniture model placed inside a stone-walled room, highlighting its atmospheric and functional design.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca3a5e5cf3b544eac2a0e0d54d531a0670ab4f44_0.webp)

![Purple Minecraft Commands & Permissions Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b241133d59451c5ee05bce2436ed382ab430dde.png)

![commands description and permissions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91eae5ac54b5c030eb5dd457c87bf07aac1d712b_0.webp)
